name: SkyStream Analytics Dashboard
description: Real-time flight tracking and business intelligence — 11 streaming Gold tables

widgets.title: ✈️  Aircraft in the Air Right Now
widgets.query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT icao24) AS total_airborne FROM silver.flights WHERE on_ground = false AND snapshot_time_ts >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 2 MINUTES

widgets.title: 🌍 Top 15 Countries by Active Flights
widgets.query: SELECT origin_country, COUNT(DISTINCT icao24) AS active_aircraft FROM silver.flights WHERE on_ground = false AND snapshot_time_ts >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 2 MINUTES GROUP BY origin_country ORDER BY active_aircraft DESC LIMIT 15

widgets.title: 🔴 Flight Alerts (Rapid Descent / Abnormal Altitude)
widgets.query: SELECT alert_generated_at, icao24, callsign, origin_country, alert_type, altitude_m, vertical_rate, latitude, longitude FROM gold.flight_alerts WHERE alert_generated_at >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 30 MINUTES ORDER BY alert_generated_at DESC LIMIT 50

widgets.title: 📊 Flight Phase Distribution (Last 5 min)
widgets.query: SELECT flight_phase, SUM(aircraft_count) AS total FROM gold.flight_phase_stats WHERE window_start >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 10 MINUTES GROUP BY flight_phase

widgets.title: 📈 Hourly Traffic Trend — Top 5 Countries (Last 24h)
widgets.query: SELECT window_start, origin_country, unique_aircraft FROM gold.hourly_traffic WHERE window_start >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 24 HOURS AND origin_country IN (SELECT origin_country FROM gold.hourly_traffic WHERE window_start >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR GROUP BY origin_country ORDER BY SUM(unique_aircraft) DESC LIMIT 5) ORDER BY window_start

widgets.title: 🏢 Live Airline Market Share (Top 20)
widgets.query: SELECT airline_icao, SUM(active_aircraft) AS active_aircraft, ROUND(AVG(market_share_pct), 2) AS avg_market_share_pct FROM gold.airline_market_share WHERE window_start >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 15 MINUTES GROUP BY airline_icao ORDER BY active_aircraft DESC LIMIT 20

widgets.title: 📦 Cargo Flow by Carrier (Last 30 min)
widgets.query: SELECT carrier_name, SUM(distinct_aircraft) AS aircraft, SUM(estimated_tonnage_mt) AS estimated_tons FROM gold.cargo_flow WHERE window_start >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 30 MINUTES GROUP BY carrier_name ORDER BY aircraft DESC

widgets.title: 🛬 Airport Congestion Scores (Current)
widgets.query: SELECT airport_name, approaching, departing, total_in_vicinity, congestion_score, congestion_level FROM gold.airport_congestion WHERE window_start >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 10 MINUTES ORDER BY congestion_score DESC

widgets.title: 🏖️ Tourism Demand Signal — Inbound Flights to Top Destinations
widgets.query: SELECT region_name, SUM(inbound_aircraft) AS inbound_flights, MAX(origin_countries) AS source_countries FROM gold.tourism_demand_signal WHERE window_start >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR GROUP BY region_name ORDER BY inbound_flights DESC

widgets.title: ⛽ Estimated Fuel Burn by Country (Last 1h, kg)
widgets.query: SELECT origin_country, SUM(fuel_burn_kg) AS total_fuel_kg, SUM(co2_tonnes) AS total_co2_tonnes FROM gold.fuel_burn_estimate WHERE window_start >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR GROUP BY origin_country ORDER BY total_fuel_kg DESC LIMIT 15

widgets.title: 📉 Economic Activity Index — Latest by Country
widgets.query: SELECT origin_country, unique_aircraft, economic_activity_index, activity_signal, window_start FROM gold.economic_activity_index WHERE window_start = (SELECT MAX(window_start) FROM gold.economic_activity_index) ORDER BY economic_activity_index DESC LIMIT 20

widgets.title: 🗺️ Route Demand Surge Zones (Last 15 min)
widgets.query: SELECT lat_zone, lon_zone, flight_count, demand_vs_world_avg_pct, demand_signal FROM gold.route_demand_index WHERE window_start >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 30 MINUTES AND demand_signal != 'NORMAL' ORDER BY demand_vs_world_avg_pct DESC LIMIT 30

alerts.name: Rapid Descent Spike
alerts.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM gold.flight_alerts WHERE alert_type = 'RAPID_DESCENT' AND alert_generated_at >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTES
alerts.message: ⚠️ SkyStream Alert: More than 5 rapid descent events detected in the last 5 minutes. Check gold.flight_alerts for details.

alerts.name: Airport Critical Congestion
alerts.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM gold.airport_congestion WHERE congestion_level = 'CRITICAL' AND window_start >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 10 MINUTES
alerts.message: 🔴 SkyStream Alert: One or more airports have reached CRITICAL congestion level.

alerts.name: Tourism Surge Detected
alerts.query: SELECT region_name, SUM(inbound_aircraft) AS inbound FROM gold.tourism_demand_signal WHERE window_start >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 15 MINUTES GROUP BY region_name HAVING inbound > 20
alerts.message: 📈 SkyStream: Tourism surge detected at one or more destinations. Check gold.tourism_demand_signal.
